headline: Sensex and Nifty under pressure as crude oil hits $107 amid global supply concerns and recent market crash

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices rose to $107 due to the US-Iran deal stalemate and supply fears
The market is reacting to a previous session crash where the Sensex fell over 1,100 points
Investor sentiment is dampened by the loss of Rs 7.4 lakh crore in market capitalization
Technical weakness is evident as ten stocks crossed below their 200-day moving averages
whatHappening: HCLTech's arm is acquiring Robotiq.ai for 9 million euros to bolster its tech portfolio
Coforge has appointed Akhil Gupta as its new chairperson to lead the company's board
The US has exempted Indian speciality drugs from 100% tariffs, aiding the pharmaceutical sector
IPO allotments for Moneyview and A-One Steels are expected to be finalised during today's session
summary: The Indian stock market is under pressure as crude oil prices climb to $107 per barrel amid global supply fears and a recent market crash. Despite broader volatility, HCLTech and Natco Pharma announced strategic investments, while the US provided a boost to the pharma sector with tariff exemptions. Investors are also tracking multiple IPO allotments and listings scheduled for today's session.
